description: This file defines the FollowersController class which handles HTTP requests related to following and unfollowing user profiles within the application. It leverages dependency injection of IMediator for sending commands and uses route attributes for defining API endpoints.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling follow and unfollow operations for user profiles.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to follow a user profile specified by username.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to unfollow a user profile specified by username.
